name: ROS 2
description: Install ROS 2 and the tools needed to develop ROS packages.

distro.description: ROS 2 distribution to install. By default, select the recommended distribution for the container's Ubuntu release.

additionalPackages.description: Space-separated ROS package suffixes to install in addition to the selected metapackage, without the ros-<distro>- prefix.

workspace.description: Workspace whose install/setup.sh file should be sourced when present.
